The Chemical Reactor turns farm chemistry into three products.
# NPK Fertilizer
- 1 Basic Slag + 1 Wood Ash + 100 mB Ammonia make 2 NPK Fertilizer. The reactor has two item slots, one for each.
- It adds 15 nutrients to Loam Farmland (filling it), and enriches it: until those nutrients run out, the crop on it grows twice as fast instead of 1.5 times. Jade shows "Enriched".
- It works in the Fertilizer Spreader too.

# Nutrient Solution
- 1 NPK Fertilizer + 1,000 mB Water make 1,000 mB Nutrient Solution.
- It feeds the Hydroponic Cell (50 mB a harvest) and the Greenhouse Array (25 mB).
# Biodiesel
- 100 mB Seed Oil + 25 mB Ethanol make 100 mB Biodiesel.
- A Fuel Burner fuel: 160 HU/t, up to 1,000°C. It doesn't burn in the Gas Turbine Array.
